info.name: Smartling REST API Reference Account & Projects Locales API

params.name: localeIds
params.description: Optional parameter to filter to the specified list of locales.

params.name: supportedOnly
params.description: Fetch only supported locales. Otherwise fetch all locales. Default value is "true".

details](/#operation/getProjectDetails).
